entities.name: Klazina Jansdotter
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch, an impulsive and ill-tempered Kjeldoran knight who fought Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Order of the Sacred Torch
entities.description: An elite cadre of Kjeldoran knights and paladins who fought Lim-Dûl's forces.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer whose undead legions threatened Kjeldor; defeated and banished in Lim-Dûl's Battle.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Klazina's heroic friend and fellow knight.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: An explorer who returned from a disastrous voyage west and helped fight the undead.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Priest of Mikkel's church who creates a disk of sunlight against the dead.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Halvor's protegee who bears the mark of the Elder Druid.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: An Elder Druid who comes to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn and chants the song of Freyalise.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: A knight of the Order of Stromgald who allied with Lim-Dûl and became undead.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess whose song stripped the undead of life.

entities.name: Klausson
entities.description: Klazina's former leader, turned into a ghoul and immolated.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Cast the fireball that saved Klazina.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: The battle where Lim-Dûl was defeated and banished.

entities.name: Feast of Kjeld
entities.description: A holiday the travelers sought to reach.

events.summary: Klazina, Lucilde and Disa are caught in a storm and take refuge in Mikkel's church with Halvor and Kaysa.
events.quote: the three women were caught by a storm and forced to seek refuge in the village of Mikkel

events.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa and says Halvor will be killed when the undead villagers attack.
events.quote: Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

events.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he allied with Lim-Dûl and became undead.
events.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul

events.summary: The knights fight the undead villagers; Kolbjörn and Kaysa's song of Freyalise destroys them.
events.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

events.summary: Kaysa leaves with Kolbjörn for Fyndhorn; Klazina notices Avram's corpse is missing.
events.quote: Klazina realized that Avram's corpse was not among the bodies.

events.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Klazina is saved from the ghoul Klausson by Jodah's fireball and leads the counterattack.
events.quote: She was saved by Jodah casting a fireball to immolate the former Sacred Torch leader

relations.quote: was the leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch
who fought the forces of the necromancer Lim-Dûl
Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul
